name: [Equip] Gemini spend jumped
message:
Billed output tokens (answers plus thinking) crossed 2M in an hour.

A normal hour is a few thousand: the pipeline only translates what changed, and a whole 870-field course is roughly 400k output tokens all in. Two million means one of three things, in order of likelihood:

1. **The model changed.** A thinking model spends ~840 hidden tokens per string and bills them as output — six times the answer. Check GEMINI_MODEL against MEASURED_GEMINI_MODELS in app/core/config.py; the backend also logs a warning at boot when it is running an unmeasured model.
2. **A loop.** A job re-translating the same course, or the sweep queueing a course it can never complete. Check /api/v1/admin/translations/queue-status for a course with climbing attempts.
3. **Real work.** A bulk import or a newly switched-on language. Legitimate — and worth knowing about anyway.
